'''Kohl Seerdon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was aware of the tactics of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Moff Seerdon is notoriously...unforgiving.|Kasan Moor|<ref name="RS I" />}}
===The Clone Wars===
In the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Kohl Seerdon was a military [[Officer/Legends|officer]] from [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he replaced [[Hiram Drayson/Legends|Hiram Drayson]] as commander of Chandrila's defense forces. He also was a member of the [[Security and Intelligence Council]], which was [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal war committee. 

When [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]] his [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Seerdon was made [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of [[Sector 3 (Oversector)|Sector 3]] and assumed the role of commander of the [[Third Mid Rim Army|3rd Sector Army]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> Seerdon later arranged for his son, [[Maximillian Seerdon|Maximillian]], to have a ranking position in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]].<ref name="Undwerworld">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/89/indexp3.html|text=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues|int=Underworld Appendix: Swoops, Spice, and Wretched Rogues}}</ref>

===Galactic Civil War (Seerdon Campaign)===
[[File:Seerdonshuttle.jpg|thumb|200px|Seerdon's shuttle over Chandrila.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Seerdon held control over the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] and its [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas [[Mining/Legends|mines]]. He also had a [[Weapons Research Facility]] on the planet [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]. During the war, Seerdon started consolidating forces to take over [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] supplies on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. The Rebel Alliance watched his moves closely. He was one of the most dangerous enemies of the Rebel Alliance [[Squadron/Legends|flight group]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[1 ABY/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="RS I" />

After Rogue Squadron [[Escape from Fest|attacked]] the snow planet [[Fest/Legends|Fest]] and destroyed his research facility, Seerdon [[Blockade on Chandrila|attacked]] and blockaded a [[Nayli|city]] on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], home planet of [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and Seerdon himself. Rogue Squadron halted his attack, forcing Seerdon, who was overseeing the attack, to flee in a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]]. While Rogue Squadron launched a [[Raid on Sullust|retaliatory raid]] on a [[Capacitor (Sullust)|Capacitor]] on the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], Seerdon [[Attack on Thyferra|invaded]] Thyferra and took control of the planet's bacta factories. Rogue Squadron counter-attacked, outmaneuvering Seerdon's forces.

===Moff Seerdon's last stand===
After losing control of the captured bacta, Seerdon engaged Rogue Leader [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in his heavily modified [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]]. After a harrowing dogfight, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] defeated him. The shuttle exploded, instantly killing the Imperial Moff, resulting in a Rebel victory.<ref name="RS I" />

==Personality & traits==
{{Quote|Rebel scum, this is Moff Seerdon. Your resistance is useless. As you can see, I have blockaded the city, and Chandrila is now mine. You will surrender, or I will shoot you all down.|Seerdon to Rogue Squadron during the Blockade of Chandrila|<ref name="RS I" />}}
Moff Seerdon was unforgiving to those who failed him, and considered it the way of the universe that the weak should give away to the strong.<ref name="RS I" /> He was also greedy.<ref name="RS I guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Seerdon serves as the main antagonist in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]. Kohl Seerdon was voiced by [[Neil Ross]].

Seerdon is also one of the Imperials in the skirmish mode of ''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]''.
